title: Survival Game Authoritative 119-Mechanic Scope Registry
provenance: The user's detailed MyProject2 catalog and MEKANIK_DERINLIK_PLANI.md describe a broader ~480–500-item catalog; they are domain-coverage references, not an exact historical 119-item list.

A historical report says 119 checks passed, but the exact 119 names were not found in the reviewed source files. This registry defines the canonical scope from this commit onward; it does not claim to recover the old test list.
rules: M001–M119 are stable IDs; never renumber or reuse a retired ID.
Every entry has one intended primary owner system. Dependencies are expressed as mechanic IDs.
All entries begin unreviewed. Scope inclusion is not evidence of implementation, build success, or runtime success.
A failed operation must not partially mutate authoritative state or consume resources.
Static review, automated tests, Unreal Engine 5.8 build, and editor/runtime validation are separate gates.
